## Parent amendment: private B handoff ledger, 2026-11-03

Approve the buyer-private variant recorded in comment6592276148. This supersedes the ownership-grant row in comment6592176495 for the stage1 handoff probe only. The pinned source confirms `DiagnosticOwnershipGrants.source` rejects every order whose audience is not `listing_public`; changing B to public would change the scenario and add publication state. Keep the original buyer-private A/B semantics.

The only approved stage1 handoff ledger is:

`create0 -> physical authorization1 -> distinct reviewer assignment2 -> distinct selected technician assignment3 -> confirm4 -> arrive5 -> no ownership grant -> first classified raw observation6 -> provenance stage/upload6 -> one retained evidence append7 -> proof issue/read7`

The new `DiagnosticContinuityHandoff.e2e.spec.ts` probe may assert literal `expectedOrderVersion: 7` in its unchanged full DTO. Before the handoff read, independently assert the persisted B order version and the issued proof's candidate order-version pin are both literal7. The writer must verify each event and each unchanged-version step in this exact order. If any additional B mutation is required, stop and return a revised ledger before changing the oracle.

Keep the original `DiagnosticContinuityHandoff.spec.ts` literal1 and all source assertions byte-for-byte unchanged. Keep literal HTTP200, exact `no-store, private`, the complete `.toEqual` DTO, proof/status/result/cursor/scope fields, proof-detail and actor/privacy controls, and the real foreign assignment followed by the exact scoped-empty DTO. Do not add a public listing, publication authorization, ownership grant, response normalization, computed expected number, number matcher, backdated/reset state or unsupported seed.

This amendment changes one fixture-specific numeral and removes an inapplicable grant from the approved ledger. It authorizes no other case, source path, production behavior, resource, package command or runtime action. The same writer may continue only the held affected offline work after recording this amendment and rechecking its existing identity/settings/slot. Runtime remains behind final-byte/lifecycle audit and explicit release. #938 and A remain OPEN/unaccepted; #936 runtime, #937 maintenance, PR904 and B/C/activation gates are unchanged.
